name: big turn back stretch
description: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
